business_problem: Cut bioinformatics run costs by 70% per report with Gemini platform and ensured regulatory confidence through a secure-by-design Virtual Private Cloud architecture
solution_summary: Cut bioinformatics run costs by 70% per report with Gemini platform and ensured regulatory confidence through a secure-by-design Virtual Private Cloud architecture Reduced data maintenance costs by 30% using Cloud Storage Enabled real-time data visualization using Cloud Run and Firebase Key components include Gemini platform coordinates multi-agent workflows, tool calling, and governed automation across the application; BigQuery stores and queries the analytics and AI-ready datasets that power the workload; Cloud Storage stores large files, lake data, or static assets that feed downstream analytics and applications; Cloud Run runs serverless or virtualized application services with elastic scale for production AI workloads; Firebase provides the application backend and mobile services that connect customer-facing experiences to the platform. Reported outcomes include Accelerated genomics annotation from eight weeks to under four weeks with BigQuery.
